name: Open a selected project and view its image gallery
covers: smooth portrait hover enlargement and return
description: Verifies a selected work card opens a large project viewer with its description and visual gallery.
steps: Inspect the project statement and first gallery image
Scroll to About and move the pointer over the portrait, then move it away
expected: A large project modal opens with the project statement and gallery navigation; portrait and landscape images retain their original aspect ratios without cropping or stretching. The About section displays Ryan’s portrait larger than the former monogram, smoothly enlarges it on hover, and returns it to its normal size when the pointer leaves.

name: Automatically advance and loop project images
description: Verifies the gallery advances through the project visuals and cycles back to the beginning.
steps: Open a project with multiple images
Wait for the next image to appear
expected: Images advance automatically every two seconds with a right-to-left wipe, the project modal remains open throughout each transition, and the gallery returns to its first image after the last.

name: View the motion work as separate video clips
covers: video downloads disabled in player controls
description: Verifies the Visual Experiments project presents the selected short clips as videos rather than running them through the image carousel.
steps: Play one clip using its player controls
expected: Three separate video players are displayed and the image carousel timing and wipe transition are not applied to them.

name: Navigate portfolio sections on mobile
description: Verifies visitors can navigate the portfolio on a narrow screen and the project viewer remains usable.
steps: Open the portfolio at mobile width
Choose Work and open a project
expected: The menu closes, the Work section is reached, and the project modal fits within the mobile viewport.

name: Use the contact call to action
description: Verifies the contact action reveals direct email, WhatsApp and Instagram destinations.
expected: The contact panel displays direct email, WhatsApp and Instagram options. Each opens its corresponding composer or direct-message destination in the same tab without spawning a pop-up window.
